verdict.rationale: Interview self-scheduling is a fair question for an ATS like Lever, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents candidate booking links, live calendar availability, team calendar sync, or timezone handling. The only related item is a terse "SMS scheduling and rich messaging built-in" claim. It is ambiguous whether that means scheduling messages or interviews, and it describes no candidate-facing booking from calendar availability, so it is an adjacent feature at most.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
